jobDescription:
About Loadshare: Loadshare Networks is a technology-driven new-age logistics company. We are India’s leading solution for last-mile logistics, impacting millions of lives every day through our extensive network of hubs across the country. With a robust tech foundation and strong operational discipline, we've achieved a CAGR of 114% over the past 6 years. Our technology platforms power all legs of transportation for some of India’s largest clients through deep integrations:
- On intra city logistics, our tech drives food delivery, quick commerce, e-commerce and grocery for all the majors.
- Our intercity technology powers part truck Load, full truck load, linehaul and warehousing for large enterprises. We also build strong supply facing apps and platforms for digitizing lakhs of delivery riders, fleet owners and transporters to build out a fully connected supply chain ecosystem. Founded in 2017, we are a Series C startup backed by Tiger Global, Matrix Partners, Stellaris, CDC and other marquee names. Our tech platform handles half a million shipments a day. We believe there’s a 20X opportunity ahead of us in the next few years, and tech is at core for helping us capture this opportunity. Our founders are Raghuram Talluri (CEO, ex- Myntra, Mc Kinsey), Pramod Nair (CTO, ex- Freecharge, Snapdeal, Mart Mobi) and Rakib Ahmed (Co-Founder, ICICI, Lunate Technologies). Our founding team comprises smart and driven folks from Bain, BCG, Snapdeal, Kearney, DHL, EY and ex-entrepreneurs. To know more about us, visit www.loadshare.net. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
● Support business finance operations with a strong focus on the company's immediate goals and mission. ● Conduct contract reviews and other detailed tasks. ● Analyze financial data to drive decision-making. ● Collaborate with cross-functional teams for operational efficiency. Ideal Candidate Should Have: ● Minimum of 3 years of experience in logistics/ecommerce, preferably in business finance. ● High level of ownership and responsibility. ● Strong analytical skills with the ability to anticipate and communicate second and third-order consequences. ● A bias for execution and getting things done. Preferred Skills: ● Proficiency in Excel and SQL is highly desirable. ● Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset. What We Offer: ● Opportunity to work in a dynamic and fast-growing company. ● A chance to understand and influence business operations from the ground up. ● Potential for career growth, possibly leading business units in the future. If you are passionate about logistics, possess a strong analytical mindset, and are eager to learn and grow, we would love to hear from you.

jobDescription:
About Loadshare: Load Share is building the future of intracity logistics in India. We’re a Series C startup backed by marquee investors like Tiger Global, Matrix Partners, Stellaris, Bee Next, BII, Filter Capital , and others. With a robust mix of tech, data, and ground execution, we're enabling hyperlocal commerce across 500+ Indian cities and towns—tier 1 to tier 3+. We power last-mile logistics for some of the biggest names in India: Swiggy, Zomato, Flipkart, Amazon, Blinkit, Meesho, Big Basket, Zepto , and many more. Our tech and Saa S platforms handle over 4M+ orders per day , including 700K+ through our rider fleet. The

ROLE:
Where Business Meets Data Science
We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Hyperlocal Business Unit —the fastest growing part of Load Share. This isn’t your typical ML role. You'll be at the intersection of real-time rider allocation, business margins, customer experience, and fair pay to gig workers. You'll have full ownership and freedom to rethink how orders get assigned, how riders move, and how we balance profitability with empathy and excellence. Your mission, should you choose to accept: Make our allocation engine smarter and faster , using data science, machine learning, and a bit of madness. Every 0.1% improvement you drive scales across lacs of deliveries and thousands of riders . What You’ll Work On Rider Allocation Engine: Improve how we assign orders to riders using ML, optimization, and predictive modeling to improve margins, reduce wait times, and increase batchability. Rider Earnings vs. Business Margins: Build models that find the sweet spot between paying riders fairly and hitting profitability goals—without compromising on customer experience. Demand-Supply Matching: Create algorithms to anticipate demand, shape rider shifts across space and time, and reduce delivery failures in hotspots and dark zones. CX & SLA Optimization: Use historical data to predict SLA risks and proactively re-route or re-assign in real-time. Experimentation & Impact: Design A/B tests to validate everything you ship. What you build, you own. Scale ML in Production: Work with engineering to ship robust, real-time data science solutions that touch live operations daily. Why This Role is Cool Real-World Impact: Your models will affect lacs of orders and thousands of livelihoods every single day . Freedom to Experiment: You get a playground with real data, full support from leadership, and space to try bold ideas. Full Stack Data Science: From ideation to shipping models to influencing business decisions, you’ll do it all. Tech + Ops Fusion: See your work directly improve operations, rider morale, and customer happiness—in days, not quarters. Incredible Team: Work with some of the sharpest minds in logistics, ops, and engineering. Quick Commerce Revolution: You get to be in the foreground of the QC revolution, shaping how 3Ps help solve the stress. What We’re Looking For 4+ years of experience in Data Science/ML/OR solving complex real-world problems Strong in Python, SQL, and ML frameworks Good grounding in optimization, statistics, experimentation, and business sense Curious mind, strong communication skills, and a bias for action. Bonus Points If You Have Worked on last-mile logistics, food delivery, or hyperlocal services Built real-time systems or worked closely with engineering on model deployment Experience with geospatial data , ETA models, or dynamic pricing Passion for making tech more inclusive for gig workers and emerging markets Ready to Redefine Hyperlocal Logistics? Join us. Help build a system that delivers millions of packages, changes thousands of lives, and sets the gold standard for modern intracity logistics— using data .

title: Senior Product Analyst
jobDescription:
About Loadshare: Load Share is a fast-growing, asset-light logistics platform powering intra-city (food delivery, quick commerce, e-commerce). Our proprietary tech onboards and manages hundreds of thousands of delivery partners—moving over 4 Lakh shipments daily on our ops and 25 Lakh shipments daily on our Saa S. Founded in 2017 and now a Series C startup, Load Share is backed by Tiger Global, Matrix, Stellaris, and CDC. We’re on track for a 20× scale-up in the next few years. If you want to build mission-critical analytics at the intersection of tech and logistics, Loadshare is where you’ll make it happen. What You’ll Own- End-to-End Metric Ownership- You’ll own our core business growth metrics—acquisition, activation, retention, referral and revenue. Design and maintain live dashboards, set weekly targets, and lead business reviews. Data-Driven Opportunity Identification
- Brainstorm problem statements and convert business problem statements into data problem statements. Identify highest-impact ideas for product or process improvements. Run & Learn from Experiments- Plan simple A/B or pilot tests, track the right metrics, analyze results, and recommend whether to scale or roll back. Insight Storytelling- Turn complex analyses into crisp, narratives, reports, and dashboards that guide executive decisions. Data QA & Automation- Review reports for accuracy before they go live, identify and fix data quality issues, and build or automate ETL pipelines. Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Work closely with Product, Marketing, Sales and Support teams to translate your insights into prioritized roadmaps and process changes. What We’re Looking For- 3+ years in Product/Growth Analytics
- Direct experience owning funnel metrics (e.g., MAU, activation, retention cohorts). Analytics capabilities- You’re comfortable writing SQL queries across multiple tables, and have advanced understanding of Python and data manipulation packages (Pandas, Numpy). Strong Statistics & Experimentation- Comfortable with statistical methods and data patterns (regression checks, simple clustering, A/B-test analysis). Dashboard & Visualization Expertise- You build and maintain visual reports and dashboards in Metabase, Looker, Tableau or similar that drive decisions. Collaborative Problem Solver- You can structure problems, partner seamlessly with diverse teams to solve the problems in a way that shows business impact. Bias for Action & Ownership- If data or dashboards don’t exist, you build them yourself—no hand-offs. Exceptional Communication- Clearly explain data findings and insights to technical or non-technical stakeholders. Continuous Improvement & Innovation- Regularly seeks feedback and experiments with new approaches. Preferred background- We think someone with a top-tier engineering education, along with experience at a fast-growing B2C startup, could be the right fit.
